name: Reviewer Two
description: An AI skill for evidence-grounded scientific manuscript review. Install or load it in a supported, authorized host, then choose first-round or revision-round review. Includes usage guidance and version updates.
features: Versioned source and installation guidance for the independent skill
Requires an authorized private runtime and explicit manuscript access permission
First-round and revision-round review workflows in the supported host
Evidence-grounded support for human reviewers; scientific judgment remains with the reviewer

history.notes: Reviewer Two skill installation and usage guidance is available on AimatraLab, with versioned source and update information.

zh.description: 用于循证科学论文审阅的 AI Skill。在受支持且获授权的宿主中安装或加载后，选择初审或修回审稿模式。提供使用指南和版本更新记录。
features: 提供独立技能的固定版本源码与安装说明
需要获授权的私有运行环境及明确的稿件访问许可
在受支持的宿主中开展首轮或修订轮审阅
以证据支持人工审稿，科学判断仍由审稿人负责
